decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - No development shall take place until a verification plan providing details of the data that will be collected in order to demonstrate that the works set out in point 3 of condition 16 of planning approval 00967/F/P16 are complete and identifying any requirements for longer-term monitoring of pollutant linkages, maintenance and arrangements for contingency action. Any changes to these components require the express consent of the local planning authority. The scheme shall be implemented as approved.
Condition : 2 - No development shall take place until details of gas protection measure have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.
description: Details of contamination report required by condition 16 of planning permission 00967/F/P1 dated 14/10/2008 for the erection of a Royal Mail delivery office and associated ancillary development
